candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `MinSum = _val;` so SetMinSum no longer updates MinSum.
Delete the guard `if(intitalized)revert();` so SetMinSum can still change MinSum after initialization.
Replace `MinSum = _val;` with `MinSum += _val;` so MinSum accumulates instead of being overwritten.
Delete the initialization guard so SetMinSum can be called after initialization, changing when MinSum can be updated.
Assign _val + 1 to MinSum instead of _val, so the observable MinSum differs after any successful call.
Delete the assignment to MinSum so the setter no longer updates the value.
Remove the assignment to LogFile so the state variable is never set and remains address(0).
Remove the intitalized guard so the function can overwrite LogFile even after initialization.
Replace the assignment target value with msg.sender so LogFile stores the caller's address instead of _log.
Change the value passed to LogFile.AddMessage from msg.value to msg.value + 1, so the logged amount after a Put call differs.
Delete the LogFile.AddMessage call so no log entry is recorded for a Put call.
Change the AddMessage sender argument from msg.sender to address(this), so the logged sender of the Put entry differs.
Change the update condition for unlockTime from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, so unlockTime is updated even when equal.
